name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.80: fixes fridge basket price changes via the dedicated price endpoint. POST products/price was a coil-only path that pushes prices to Weimi aisles, which a gravity fridge does not have, so a fridge price change either failed as not_stocked or never reached the fridge and never bumped configVersion. The endpoint is now fridge-aware: for a fridge it sets a per-basket price override (scoped to the targeted machine so other machines showing the same product are unaffected) and re-touches config so the machine re-polls within a cycle. Complements v5.79, which bumps config on the product-editor path. Cumulative over v5.79.
